title: Local-Unitary Rigidity of Stabilizer AME States and Transversal Clifford Groups of MDS–CSS Codes
description: This preprint proves local-unitary-to-local-Clifford rigidity for additive stabilizer absolutely maximally entangled states and determines transversal Clifford structure for the associated quantum MDS–CSS codes. It includes exact finite-field classifications, computational certificates, and an explicit formal-verification boundary.
